sentences.en: I agree with you that the actor is very talented.
sentences.zh: 我同意你那个演员很有才华。

sentences.en: You shouldn't give up just because you have no talent.
sentences.zh: 你不应该因为没有天赋就放弃。

sentences.en: In Kabuki not only talent but also heredity counts.
sentences.zh: 在歌舞伎表演中，不仅要有才能，还要有家族传承。

senses.zh: 天赋，才能；人才，有才能的人；天资，才华
